description: This PHP abstract class defines a generic manager for user roles within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting and getting user information, checking roles and permissions, and abstract methods for permission and access control logic that concrete subclasses must implement.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common interface and shared functionality for managing user roles, permissions, and access control in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user and computes their roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current user object, or null if none is set.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Retrieves the roles assigned to the current user.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve accessible entities for a user, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve IDs of accessible entities for a user.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a specific entity is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check accessibility for multiple entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve properties of accessible entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to list modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a module is accessible.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a screen within a module is accessible.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve API permissions for a class.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a specific field is accessible.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch employees associated with a specific role.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract method to determine roles assigned to a user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a workflow action is permissible for the user.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve permissible workflow actions.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Abstract method to determine workflow states for given actions.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain permissions for data groups.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a collection of data group permissions.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Abstract method to get the default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Abstract method to get the home page URL.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Method indicating if ESS rights pertain to their own workflows; returns true by default.
